name: claude-skills
description: Personal Claude Code skills, versioned in git so they stay in sync across machines and accounts.

plugins.name: orchestrate
plugins.description: Plan with the expensive model, execute with cheap parallel subagents. Produces a concrete plan using the session's active model (Opus/Fable), then fans the well-specified grunt work out to parallel Sonnet subagents to save tokens.

plugins.name: rnd
plugins.description: General-purpose R&D research for any domain — software systems, tools, frameworks, techniques, infrastructure, workflows or trading. Finds existing frameworks, reference repos and practitioner evidence, then produces a decision-ready report with a Claude Code handoff prompt.

plugins.name: skill-scout
plugins.description: Before a substantial task, finds existing agent skills that fit it, vets and security-reviews them, installs only the ones you approve, then continues the task.

plugins.name: trading-system-review
plugins.description: Fresh-eyes senior-trader review of an existing algorithmic trading system: re-runs the backtest, computes deflated Sharpe / PBO / Monte Carlo / regime stats with a bundled script, researches today's market and new techniques on the web (CloakBrowser fallback), scores a 10-dimension rubric with hard gates, and renders an offline HTML report with charts and a deploy / incubate / revamp / retire verdict. Also has a reference mode that vets someone else's GitHub trading repo or framework before you learn from or build on it. Delegates through the orchestrate skill.
